papers.title: jepctl: Putting Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures in Practitioners' Hands
papers.abstract: jepctl is a single-binary local runtime written in Rust with no Python dependency that loads published JEPA-style checkpoints (I-JEPA, V-JEPA 2, DINOv2, AudioMAE), strictly validates weight coverage, and serves embeddings over REST, SSE, and CLI. This engineering report documents the systems architecture, runtime constraints, and single-machine performance profiles measured on an Apple Silicon (M5 Pro) testbench. It packages four worked integrations: few-shot inspection and recognition, an online latent world model predicting camera dynamics, an end-to-end robot arm controller driven by latent distance minimisation, and a multimodal audio-visual companion. Source code and models are open source (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/younss/jepctl
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提供JEPA世界模型的工程化运行时与潜在世界模型示例，但未涉及工程仿真、FEA或代理模型，与用户的RL与工程仿真交叉方向仅间接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a systems/runtime engineering report for JEPA checkpoints with robotics and multimodal demos; it contains no FEA/FEM data, no surrogate modeling for engineering simulation, and no physics-based design optimization.

summary_zh.result: 在Apple Silicon上给出性能画像，并展示少样本检测、潜在世界模型、机械臂控制和多模态四个集成示例。

summary_en.motivation: To make JEPA-style latent world models practically accessible to practitioners without a Python stack.
summary_en.method: A single-binary Rust runtime loads published JEPA checkpoints, validates weight coverage, and serves embeddings over REST, SSE, and CLI.
summary_en.result: Single-machine performance profiles on Apple Silicon are reported alongside four worked integrations including an online latent world model and a robot arm controller.
summary_en.validation: Validated through runtime performance measurements on a single-machine testbench and demonstration of four integration cases.

papers.title: Active machine learning using MCMC Bayesian neural networks
papers.abstract: Background Standard neural networks require large labelled datasets for strong generalization, which is often costly to annotate. Active learning (AL) reduces annotation costs by selecting the most informative samples for labelling based on model uncertainty, and Bayesian methods are a natural source of such uncertainty estimates. Approximate Bayesian methods such as Monte Carlo Dropout (MC Dropout) are scalable but can introduce systematic approximation errors in low-data regimes, whereas Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) provides higher-fidelity posterior estimates but is typically too computationally expensive for deep learning. We note that MCMC and AL are potentially complementary, since AL is designed to keep the labelled set small, which is exactly the regime in which MCMC is most tractable. Methods We investigate whether a small Bayesian neural network trained with MCMC outperforms a larger network using MC Dropout, when both use the same query function, Power Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreement (PowerBALD), across eight tabular classification datasets, an active learning setting with a 100-sample annotation budget, and matched supervised-learning baselines at 100 samples and at full training-set size. Results Within the 100-sample annotation budget, the small MCMC-based model achieved higher balanced accuracy than the MC Dropout model in 6 of 8 active learning tasks, and in 4 of 8 tasks in the matched 100-sample supervised setting, with one additional tie. The active learning procedure also matched or exceeded the performance of training on the full dataset in 5 of 8 tasks while using only a small fraction of the annotations. Conclusions These results suggest that MCMC is a viable and, in this constrained-budget setting, often preferable alternative to approximate Bayesian inference for active learning, though we do not claim that it is a generally superior inference method outside this low-annotation regime.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究MCMC贝叶斯神经网络主动学习，可迁移至FEA代理模型的高效采样与不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no biomedical or implant mechanics context, and no constrained optimization or simulation-based validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准神经网络依赖大量标注数据，主动学习可降低标注成本，但近似贝叶斯方法在低数据下存在误差。
summary_zh.method: 在100样本标注预算下，比较小型MCMC贝叶斯神经网络与较大MC Dropout网络，使用PowerBALD查询函数，在八个表格分类数据集上评估。
summary_zh.result: MCMC模型在6/8主动学习任务中平衡准确率更高，并在5/8任务中仅用少量标注即达到或超过全数据集训练性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在八个表格分类数据集上进行数值基准测试，并与监督学习基线对比。

summary_en.motivation: Standard neural networks demand large labeled datasets, and active learning with approximate Bayesian uncertainty can be unreliable in low-data regimes.
summary_en.method: A small Bayesian neural network trained with MCMC is compared against a larger MC Dropout network using the same PowerBALD query function across eight tabular classification datasets under a 100-sample annotation budget.
summary_en.result: The MCMC-based model achieved higher balanced accuracy in six of eight active learning tasks and matched or exceeded full-dataset training in five of eight tasks using only a small annotation fraction.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarking on eight tabular classification datasets with matched supervised-learning baselines at 100 samples and full training-set size.
